* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

#### Actual Behavior
```
plugin.json agents vs agents/ directory mismatch:
  1a2
  > architectural-probe.md
  44a46
  > second-source-verifier.md
```

Two new agents were committed to `plugins/dso/agents/` (architectural-probe.md, second-source-verifier.md) but not registered in `plugins/dso/.claude-plugin/plugin.json`.
